annotations.title: Build Offline REA HAR-to-AgentEnv Sandbox ($299 Stripe / $3.50 x402 USDC / Free Preview)

description: Converts a live web workflow URL or recorded HTTP Archive (.har v1.2) into an offline deterministic REA AgentEnv MCP sandbox (callable read/write tools + state transitions) paired with 8 multi-step evaluation tasks, 3-vendor Judge-Trust reward verifiers, a 300-DPI Executive Benchmark PDF, and a SHA-256 verified .zip bundle ($299 Stripe / $3.50 x402 USDC, or set preview_mode=true for an instant free Edge dry-run).

client_name.description: Organization or team name commissioning the AgentEnv sandbox.

contact_email.description: Delivery email for the compiled AgentEnv .zip and 300-DPI Executive PDF.

observed_endpoints.description: Optional list of key REST/JSON endpoints (e.g. 'GET /v1/gifts', 'POST /v1/orders').

payment_token.description: Optional Stripe checkout session / payment_intent ID or x402 USDC payment receipt.

preview_mode.description: Set true to run a free instant Edge dry-run returning projected MCP tools and 8-task benchmark outline.

target_url.description: Optional HTTPS workflow URL to capture into a validated HAR v1.2 archive.

workflow_name.description: Name of the multi-step web or API workflow (e.g. 'Gift Cart & Promo Checkout').

name: build_rea_har_agent_sandbox
